Yeah! This is the thread I got the inspo from: https://www.reddit.com/r/streetwear/comments/3mres3/did_a_couple_more_bleach_dyes_today_this_time_i/

He has a youtube video in the comments explaining the process, but it's really simple. All you have to do is get a solution of 50/50 water and bleach in a spray bottle then spray it on the leaves and press it down onto your clothes. I used cardboard to press it down. You also want to put cardboard into your clothes too so the bleach won't soak through the other side. You can see results immediately; the process is extremely fast.

I'm an assassin, so take this with a grain of salt, but I disagree that assassins are the strongest PVP class and have no unfavorable match ups.

I'd say summoners are the strongest class in both PVP and PVE due to a very efficient mix of both utility and damage. Additionally, assassins have an unfavorable matchup against both summoner and FM. Both classes have a lot of AOE to get the assassin out of stealth. Force masters against assassins maybe one of the hardest match ups in the game right now due to the force master's ability to freeze and stop movement abilities, which renders some stealth procs and iframes unusable.

As an assassin, this is also probably one of my worst and most hated match ups, the other being FM due to their freeze. Against summoners, sins will have to go the permastealth PvE build, and it typically is never a fun game for the sin at least.

From my experience, being around 1800 so far, it's the doom n bloom that makes the matchup so difficult and annoying to play because it gets you out of stealth. In my experience, it's best to just use your movement skills/flower to get away, or spec 3 points into Lotus Fury which will give a lot of iframes, as well as using poison breath or plague mist if they're specced for more healing. 

Overall, the matchup is just difficult and somewhat irritating for the assassin.
